selected_problem: DWAC native changeset generation fails closed when it cannot produce machine-parseable validated changes.

decision_provenance.claim_limit: The selected bottleneck and route come from the checked-in DWAC controller/router contract and the post-repair fresh-main replay already recorded on canonical main; no hosted DWAC execution receipt is fabricated.

reused_dwac_assets: Taowind Code transactional changeset preimage checks and RCL authority gates
changes: The DWAC native cognition prompt now prefers the existing DWAC ChangeSetIR v0.1 contract instead of requiring only the Taowind Code-local proposal shape.
DWAC ChangeSetIR write/replace/delete operations are deterministically lowered into the existing transactional Taowind Code changeset protocol without a second model rewrite.

replace requires one exact UTF-8 preimage occurrence; existing write/delete/replace targets receive SHA-256 preimage bindings so stale candidates fail at staging rather than silently overwriting newer reality.
ChangeSetIR test argv arrays are lowered with shell-safe quoting into the existing validation command surface; no test result is invented.
Unsafe paths, forbidden generated/dependency trees, ambiguous replacements, missing delete/replace targets and non-ready IR states fail closed with an empty proposal.
The pre-existing Taowind Code native proposal format remains backward compatible.

verification.case: write + unique replace + delete + argv validation
verification.evidence: replace lowered to preimage-bound write; delete bound to prior SHA-256; argv preserved as a validation command

truth_boundaries: This cycle narrows the native complex-changeset bottleneck by making DWAC's existing formal ChangeSetIR directly consumable; it does not claim arbitrary complex repository synthesis is fully closed.
NaturalConversationRuntime must still produce a semantically correct candidate; deterministic lowering validates structure/preimages but cannot compensate for missing synthesis capability.
The hosted Developer Execution Runtime was transiently unavailable with HTTP 502, so focused local source validation is used and no hosted execution receipt is claimed.
No validation command is reported as executed merely because it appears in ChangeSetIR tests; real acceptance remains downstream and RCL-gated.
No GitHub Actions are used for this change set.
